integrity: The proof is self-contained; the included finite check is corroborative only and is not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for finite-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebras arising from a nondegenerate alternating form.
It does not classify local derivations on arbitrary two-step nilpotent Lie algebras with larger center.
The finite exhaustive check covers only the three-dimensional case over F_2; the all-dimension, all-field statement is proved symbolically.
title: Local derivations of Heisenberg Lie algebras over arbitrary fields
